text.tspan: Per request: one CRN / work-order-line case.
IO review and closing each start once per working day.
Shared records link cases; their sequence flows remain separate.

text.tspan: SLA uses postal-request receipt time. Late-notified work carries forward.
Ready-after-3pm parts use the next dispatch slot.

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; fill: rgb(34, 36, 42);
text.tspan: Refer all missed items before waiting.
Only actual receipt permits dispatch and finalisation of that item.
Keep every remaining item and its original one-day deadline.
Assumption: repeat late notices daily; record each notified item's next due date.
A different item returning does not restart these deadlines.
